Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a classic AP-MS (Co-IP) to identify interactors of S1P. While the instrument (TripleTOF 5600) can perform DIA, the workflow described (in-gel digestion of enriched bands) is characteristic of DDA. PRIDE metadata explicitly lists 'Affinity purification coupled with mass spectrometry proteomics'. A flavin modification is mentioned in the identifiedPTMStrings of the PRIDE metadata, though the main text focuses on flavination of ETF.

scope: The proteins of interest were enriched using primary antibodies immobilized on Protein G agarose beads. The enriched proteins were separated on 8–12% polyacrylamide gels. Target gel bands were cut out for in‐gel trypsin (T4019; Sigma‐Aldrich) digestion and LC‐MS/MS analysis.

Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The LC-MS/MS experiment described in the PRIDE metadata and the 'LC-MS/MS analysis' section of the text was used to screen for S1P interactors via Co-IP. The primary biological variable for the proteomics analysis is the knockout of MBTPS1 in HaCaT cells to identify binding partners (ETFA/ETFB). While the paper describes riboflavin treatment and patient disease states, these were analyzed via other assays (Seahorse, metabolomics, clinical observation) and not the primary LC-MS/MS proteomics dataset.
